1.web: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:
1.asv: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints that are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

2.web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
2.asv: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

3.web: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ;
3.asv: Blessedbethe God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ:

4.web: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love;
4.asv: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blemish before him in love:

5.web: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,
5.asv: having foreordained us unto adoption as sons through Jesus Christ unto himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

6.web: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely bestowed favor on us in the Beloved,
6.asv: to the praise of the glory of his grace, which he freely bestowed on us in the Beloved:

7.web: in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,
7.asv: in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,

8.web: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,
8.asv: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

9.web: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him
9.asv: making known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

10.web: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens, and the things on the earth, in him;
10.asv: unto a dispensation of the fulness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens, and the things upon the earth; in him, I say,

11.web: in whom also we were assigned an inheritance, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who works all things after the counsel of his will;
11.asv: in whom also we were made a heritage, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his will;

12.web: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ:
12.asv: to the end that we should be unto the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ:

13.web: in whom you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise,
13.asv: in whom ye also, having heard the word of the truth, the gospel of your salvation,—in whom, having also believed, ye were sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise,

14.web: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.
14.asv: which is an earnest of our inheritance, unto the redemption of God’s own possession, unto the praise of his glory.

15.web: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you, and the love which you have toward all the saints,
15.asv: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you, and the love which ye show toward all the saints,

16.web: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,
16.asv: cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;

17.web: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him;
17.asv: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him;

18.web: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
18.asv: having the eyes of your heart enlightened, that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

19.web: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might
19.asv: and what the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

20.web: which he worked in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,
20.asv: which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

21.web: far above all rule, and authority, and power, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.
21.asv: far above all rule, and authority, and power, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:

22.web: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,
22.asv: and he put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things to the church,

23.web: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.
23.asv: which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.
